description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog component, verifying its symbol generation and presentation logic based on device attributes such as model identifiers, device family, and friendly names.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalogTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of DeviceModelCatalog, including prefix selection, friendly name fallback, and presentation mapping.

methods.name: symbol prefers model identifier prefixes
methods.description: Tests that the symbol method correctly returns device symbol based on device family and model identifier.

methods.name: symbol uses friendly name for mac variants
methods.description: Tests that the symbol method returns friendly name-based symbols for Mac devices.

methods.name: symbol falls back to device family
methods.description: Verifies that the symbol method defaults to device family when model-specific data is unavailable.

methods.name: presentation uses bundled model mappings
methods.description: Checks that the presentation function returns the correct presentation object based on device family and identifier.
